findings.text: timerqueue_iterate_next exposes successor traversal for timer queue nodes: a null input yields null, otherwise the tree successor of the embedded link is located and a missing successor yields null, otherwise the enclosing timer record is returned.

timerqueue_linked_add inserts a linked timer node into a linked head ordered by expiry time, using a less predicate that unwraps each tree link to its enclosing timer record and compares expiry values, and forwards the boolean outcome of the underlying linked tree insertion.

Four helpers expose MMIO trace logging: pre-write and post-write accept value width address plus two caller addresses, pre-read accepts width address plus two caller addresses, post-read adds the read value, each forwarding to its matching read write post-read or post-write trace event, with a build flag enabling trace point definitions.

Boyer-Moore private state holds a pattern pointer and pattern length, a fixed bad-shift table sized by alphabet size, and a trailing variable good-shift table, with normalized pattern bytes stored immediately after the good-shift region.

Boyer-Moore initialization rejects empty patterns and length calculations that would overflow the shift table or private allocation, records flags, normalizes the pattern to upper case when ignore-case is requested or copies it otherwise, then builds bad-shift and good-shift tables.

Boyer-Moore search iterates blocks from the saved offset, aligning the pattern end inside each block, matching backwards with optional case folding, returning the absolute start on full match, otherwise advancing by the larger of the bad-character and good-suffix jumps, and returning an all-bits-set sentinel when input is exhausted.
Finite-state private state holds a token count followed by a trailing token array copied from the caller pattern, with per-token type later rewritten to internal bitmask form.

Ascii class flag has value 256 and wildcard class flag has value 512, backed by a per-type map from abstract token kinds to bitmasks and a 256-entry per-byte lookup table combining wildcard ascii and character-class bits.

Finite-state search walks tokens against streamed blocks from the saved offset, supporting single optional multi any and head-ignore recurrences, using strict mode for anchored starts versus resynchronizing after mismatch otherwise, updating the saved offset and returning match start on success or an all-bits-set sentinel on failure or exhaustion.

Finite-state initialization requires a non-empty whole-token pattern, rejects ignore-case, validates each token type and recurrence range and restricts head-ignore to a non-final first position, then copies tokens and translates abstract types through the map table, reporting invalid argument on any violation.
Knuth-Morris-Pratt private state holds a pattern pointer and length plus a trailing variable prefix table, with normalized pattern bytes stored immediately after the prefix region.

Knuth-Morris-Pratt search scans each block incrementally maintaining the length of the current prefix match with fallback through the prefix table on mismatch and optional case folding, advancing the saved offset past a full match and returning its start, or returning an all-bits-set sentinel when input ends.

Knuth-Morris-Pratt initialization rejects empty patterns and length calculations that would overflow the prefix table or private allocation, records flags, builds the prefix table from the original bytes, then stores an upper-cased copy when ignore-case is requested or a direct copy otherwise.

Three text-search algorithms register under names bm fsm and kmp, each supplying find init and pattern accessor callbacks with module ownership and list linkage, registered during module init and unregistered during module exit.

Each algorithm exposes accessors returning the stored pattern pointer and its length, reporting byte length for Boyer-Moore and Knuth-Morris-Pratt and total token-array byte size for the finite-state engine.

Undefined-behavior reporting maps each sanitizer failure code to a fixed human-readable message covering bounds shift divide remainder unreachable invalid value alignment type mismatch and integer add sub mul overflow, with groups gated by build options and a fallback message for unrecognized codes.

Type-check descriptions list eight phrases in order from load of through two downcast of forms, a reported flag occupies bit 31, and two alternate mask pairs clear that bit in either the column or the line field while leaving the other field all ones.

Boyer-Moore and Knuth-Morris-Pratt initializers treat zero length and multiplicative or additive sizing overflow as invalid argument, preventing underflowed start shifts and out-of-bounds pattern reads plus wrapped allocations with pattern data appended after variable tables.
Boyer-Moore alphabet size is 256 entries and its debug logging macro expands to nothing, so search-time diagnostics are compiled out.
